examples.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ.
examples.en: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow?

examples.ar: اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ.
examples.en: God is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light.

translation: noon, midday / also (ظَهْر) back / also (ظَهَرَ) he/it appeared

examples.ar: نُؤَدِّي صَلَاةَ الظُّهْرِ جَمَاعَةً فِي المَسْجِدِ.
examples.en: We perform the Dhuhr prayer in congregation in the mosque.
Unquestionably, the curse of God is upon the wrongdoers.
Injustice will be darknesses on the Day of Resurrection.

translation: victory, triumph, fingernail / also (ظَفِرَ) he won

examples.ar: نَالَتِ الحُرِّيَّةُ ظَفَرًا كَبِيرًا بَعْدَ الكِفَاحِ.
examples.en: Freedom achieved a great victory after the struggle.

examples.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ.
examples.en: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption, indeed some assumption is sin.
